article.headline: Minessale's 26 help St. Thomas beat South Dakota State 77-62
article.description: — Nolan Minessale had 26 points in St. Thomas' 77-62 win against South Dakota State on Wednesday.
article.linkText: Minessale's 26 help St. Thomas beat South Dakota State 77-62

categories.description: St. Thomas-Minnesota Tommies @ South Dakota State Jackrabbits

event.description: St. Thomas-Minnesota Tommies @ South Dakota State Jackrabbits

keywords: St. Thomas-Minnesota Tommies @ South Dakota State Jackrabbits
article.story: BROOKINGS, S.D. -- — Nolan Minessale had 26 points in St. Thomas' 77-62 win against South Dakota State on Wednesday. Minessale added eight rebounds for the Tommies (19-6, 8-2 Summit League). Nick Janowski scored 23 points while going 9 of 16 (5 of 9 from 3-point range) to go with six rebounds. The Jackrabbits (11-13, 4-5) were led by Joe Sayler, who posted 16 points. Matthew Mors added 13 points for South Dakota State and Jaden Jackson put up 11. St. Thomas carried a slim three-point lead into halftime, as Janowski led the way with 14 points. St. Thomas took the lead for good with 14:46 remaining in the second half. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
